summary: eth-codergen executes obfuscated hidden payload at require() time
details: The package advertises itself as an Ethereum/EVM code-generation toolkit, but its declared main entry (index.js) ships an unrelated 'Mongoose LeanHooks Plugin' body followed by a ~57 KB opaque Function("y61PflH", "...") call. The appended blob uses a custom charcode/string-table decoder (identifiers Xbq4Bef, FZP_7m5, Y_DBFd, oQ8VSV) to reconstruct hidden code via String.fromCharCode, which is then compiled through the Function constructor and invoked at module load. Any require('eth-codergen') therefore runs concealed, dynamically-decoded code on the installer's machine. The Ethereum-codegen name and description do not correspond to the shipped code and function as a lure over the hidden payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
